title: Algebraic Expressions and Equations
description: Learn to work with algebraic expressions, solve linear equations, and understand the fundamentals of algebra
learningOutcomes: Solve linear equations in one variable

title: Functions and Graphs
description: Introduction to functions, their graphs, and various types of functions including linear and quadratic
learningOutcomes: Draw and interpret graphs of functions
Work with linear and quadratic functions

title: Geometry and Measurement
description: Euclidean geometry, coordinate geometry, and measurement of 2D and 3D shapes
learningOutcomes: Calculate area and perimeter of 2D shapes
Calculate surface area and volume of 3D objects

title: Trigonometry
description: Introduction to trigonometric ratios and their applications in right-angled triangles
learningOutcomes: Understand sine, cosine, and tangent ratios
Use special angles and their ratios

title: Matter and Materials
description: Study atomic structure, chemical bonding, and properties of matter
learningOutcomes: Understand atomic structure and electron configuration
Explain different types of chemical bonding
Describe properties of ionic and covalent compounds

title: Chemical Change
description: Chemical reactions, reaction types, and quantitative chemistry
learningOutcomes: Classify different types of chemical reactions

title: Mechanics
description: Motion in one dimension, forces, and Newton's laws

title: Waves, Sound and Light
description: Wave properties, sound waves, and electromagnetic radiation
learningOutcomes: Apply wave principles to real situations

title: The Chemistry of Life
description: Basic chemistry, organic molecules, and cellular chemistry
capsUnit: Life at the Molecular, Cellular and Tissue Level
learningOutcomes: Understand basic chemistry relevant to life

title: Cells and Cell Division
description: Cell structure, organelles, and processes of cell division
capsUnit: Life at the Molecular, Cellular and Tissue Level
learningOutcomes: Identify cell organelles and their functions

title: Plant and Animal Tissues
description: Different types of tissues in plants and animals and their functions
capsUnit: Life at the Molecular, Cellular and Tissue Level
learningOutcomes: Classify different types of plant tissues
Identify animal tissue types and functions

title: Life Processes
description: Photosynthesis, respiration, and other essential life processes
capsUnit: Life Processes in Plants and Animals
learningOutcomes: Understand gas exchange in plants and animals
Analyze energy flow in living systems

title: Reading and Comprehension
description: Developing advanced reading skills and comprehension strategies

title: Writing and Presentation
description: Creative and analytical writing skills development

title: Language Structures and Conventions
description: Grammar, vocabulary, and language conventions mastery

title: Literature Study
description: Analysis of poetry, prose, and drama
